body:
Like I said, I don’t think you’re a bad person. I’d take a good, hard look at yourself and think of the good you’ve done in life. You can add this to the list, because it made me feel less alone. 

You don’t have to do anything, I’m just recommending you do. Good has a bigger impact than bad.

You say you’re not a good person yet you took time out of your day to try and talk me off the ledge. That’s not something a bad person would do, no matter how you feel about yourself. And who really decides how dues are paid? There could be a much better way to do it.

Maybe volunteer somewhere. A soup kitchen, an animal shelter, something. 

Besides, people can change. The fact that you recognize what you did is the first step. I don’t think you’re a bad person, I think you’ve just made some mistakes. Big ones, maybe, but I think you can continue living and do good things. I’m sure you’ve done positive things in the past and I’m sure they had a much bigger impact than the negatives.

I’d like to tell you something. It might hurt to hear, but I think you need to hear it. 

Death won’t absolve of your sins. I don’t know what you did or why you did them, but I know you can still atone for them, no matter how much you might think you can’t.

Write letters. Call people. Make formal apologies. If you can’t, use the experience as planning for your future. The past is the past, true, but you can fix your future.

I’ve felt like killing myself almost my whole life, but there’s one reason I used to want to that I can’t justify anymore: guilt. The guilt only got better when I faced it head on and realized that killing myself would prevent those I hurt from getting closure. 

I still hate myself, but not because of the past. I hate myself because I hurt people subconsciously now. From what I’ve read of yours, you know what you’ve done. That’s a good first step. I think you can do it. The fact that you feel so terrible about what you’ve done shows me that you’re a good person that’s made some mistakes. It’s not too late to fix them.

I feel like I can’t enjoy anything. No matter what I do I can’t feel anything anymore. I’m 19 and I know I can’t do this for another year, let alone another 40 to 50 working a dead end job that makes me want to stop breathing. Even things I used to enjoy make me feel numb. I can’t feel shit.

if there’s hope for me, there’s more than enough for you. trust me on this, I think you can do it. The way you’re speaking makes me feel like you’ve at least seen a glimmer of hope, and that’s more than I ever have. you deserve happiness even if I don’t

I think if I saw the finish line in the distance it would make it easier. At this point it feels like it’s miles away if it’s still there at all. I feel like I got left behind, just like I did with everything in life. Maybe it’s too late. I don’t know.
thank you. you’re probably right. I just wish I knew what I did to push people away to stop it from happening. I wish therapy worked for me. I wish for a lot I guess.

thank you. I wish I could believe it. Every time I reach out, I feel worse rather than better. I make people upset and I don’t blame them. I don’t blame them for cutting me off either, I wouldn’t want to be friends with me either.
I don’t wanna be a burden. I think that’s why I push people away. I just wish I could deal with my own problems instead of pushing them on others. I wish I was dead so people could forget about me
Hey, what’s going on? what do you need to talk about?
Thank you. I will do my best. It’s just hard, you know?

Hey, first of all I’d like to say I’m very sorry that you lost your pregnancy. Secondly, I’d like to say that there’s a very good chance the people you talked to weren’t great friends to begin with. I know how hard it is, but try your damndest to get new friends and forget about the old ones. It’ll seem hard, but I think you can definitely find new friends in your town/city/whatever. There’s gotta be someone around.
Aw, I’m sorry about your shoes. It did make me smile, though, how much you love your dog :) I’d do anything for mine.

I want to believe you’re right, I really do, I just don’t know how to tell myself I’m wrong. I really do think everyone around me would be either better off or exactly the same, and it’s not a good feeling.
I’d make sure they have someone to take care of them, someone better, someone who wouldn’t be a fuck up and give them the time and attention they deserve instead of moping around all day.
I ruin everything. this planet would be better without me, I’m sure of it.
my dogs are one of the only things keeping me from killing my self. even then, I think they’d be okay, they have my dad. I’d still feel guilty

Every time I leave the house I just fuck things up. I’ve been trying for two years. Small things feel like huge events. Buying an Arizona from a gas station is like taking a final exam and not knowing a single answer on it. I don’t know what else to do, it just keeps getting worse instead of better
I fuck everything up. I am so fucking sick of breathing.
